name: obsidian-share-system
description: Complete Obsidian share system with plugin, backend API, and admin panel

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd admin-panel && npm start"
scripts.build: cd obsidian-share-plugin && npm run build && cd ../admin-panel && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd obsidian-share-plugin && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npx eslint src/ && cd ../admin-panel && npm run lint
